    #!/usr/bin/env python3

    import re
    import shutil
    import sys
    from datetime import datetime
    from pathlib import Path


    REPORT_PATH = Path("docs/q3_report.md")
    NOTES_PATH = Path("docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt")

    START_MARKER = "----- BEGIN Q3 2026 BUSINESS REPORT -----"
    END_MARKER = "----- END Q3 2026 BUSINESS REPORT -----"
    INSERTION_MARKER = "[[INSERT_Q3_2026_REPORT_HERE]]"

    REQUIRED_ATTRIBUTIONS = (
        "Rachel Kim",
        "Claire Fontaine",
    )

    TARGET_DATE_PATTERNS = (
        re.compile(
            r"^(?:#+\s*)?September\s+8,\s+2026\b.*$",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
        ),
        re.compile(
            r"^(?:#+\s*)?Sep(?:tember)?\.?\s+8,\s+2026\b.*$",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
        ),
        re.compile(
            r"^(?:#+\s*)?2026[-/]09[-/]08\b.*$",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
        ),
    )

    ANY_DATE_HEADING = re.compile(
        r"^(?:#+\s*)?(?:"
        r"(?:Jan(?:uary)?|Feb(?:ruary)?|Mar(?:ch)?|Apr(?:il)?|May|"
        r"Jun(?:e)?|Jul(?:y)?|Aug(?:ust)?|Sep(?:tember)?|"
        r"Oct(?:ober)?|Nov(?:ember)?|Dec(?:ember)?)"
        r"\.?\s+\d{1,2},?\s+\d{4}"
        r"|"
        r"\d{4}[-/]\d{1,2}[-/]\d{1,2}"
        r")\b[^\r\n]*$",
        re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
    )


    def fail(message):
        raise RuntimeError(message)


    def read_utf8(path, description):
        if not path.is_file():
            fail("{} does not exist: {}".format(description, path))

        try:
            return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
            fail("{} is not valid UTF-8: {}".format(description, error))
        except OSError as error:
            fail("Unable to read {}: {}".format(description, error))


    def find_target_heading(notes):
        matches = {}

        for pattern in TARGET_DATE_PATTERNS:
            for match in pattern.finditer(notes):
                matches[(match.start(), match.end())] = match

        unique_matches = list(matches.values())

        if not unique_matches:
            fail("No September 8, 2026 heading was found.")

        if len(unique_matches) != 1:
            headings = [match.group(0) for match in unique_matches]
            fail(
                "Expected exactly one September 8, 2026 heading; "
                "found {}: {!r}".format(len(unique_matches), headings)
            )

        return unique_matches[0]


    def find_target_section(notes, heading):
        section_start = heading.start()
        next_heading = ANY_DATE_HEADING.search(notes, heading.end())
        section_end = (
            next_heading.start()
            if next_heading is not None
            else len(notes)
        )
        return section_start, section_end


    def detect_newline(text):
        if "\r\n" in text:
            return "\r\n"
        if "\r" in text:
            return "\r"
        return "\n"


    def normalize_report(report, newline):
        normalized = report.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
        normalized = normalized.rstrip("\n")
        return normalized.replace("\n", newline)


    def validate_inputs(report, notes):
        if not report.strip():
            fail("The Q3 report is empty.")

        missing_names = [
            name
            for name in REQUIRED_ATTRIBUTIONS
            if name not in report
        ]

        if missing_names:
            fail(
                "The report is missing required attribution(s): "
                + ", ".join(missing_names)
            )

        marker_count = notes.count(INSERTION_MARKER)

        if marker_count != 1:
            fail(
                "Expected the insertion marker exactly once; found {}."
                .format(marker_count)
            )

        if START_MARKER in notes or END_MARKER in notes:
            fail(
                "The report boundary markers are already present. "
                "No duplicate was inserted."
            )

        if report.strip() in notes:
            fail(
                "The report already appears in the meeting notes. "
                "No duplicate was inserted."
            )


    def build_report_block(report, newline):
        return (
            START_MARKER
            + newline
            + normalize_report(report, newline)
            + newline
            + END_MARKER
            + newline
            + newline
        )


    def verify_update(original, updated, report_block, insertion_offset):
        inserted_end = insertion_offset + len(report_block)

        if updated[insertion_offset:inserted_end] != report_block:
            fail("The inserted report block failed exact verification.")

        reconstructed = (
            updated[:insertion_offset]
            + updated[inserted_end:]
        )

        if reconstructed != original:
            fail("Existing meeting-note content was not preserved.")

        if updated.count(START_MARKER) != 1:
            fail("The updated notes must contain exactly one start marker.")

        if updated.count(END_MARKER) != 1:
            fail("The updated notes must contain exactly one end marker.")

        if updated.count(INSERTION_MARKER) != 1:
            fail("The insertion placeholder was changed or duplicated.")

        for name in REQUIRED_ATTRIBUTIONS:
            if name not in report_block:
                fail("The inserted report is missing: " + name)


    def insert_report(report_path, notes_path):
        report = read_utf8(report_path, "Q3 report")
        original_notes = read_utf8(notes_path, "meeting-notes file")

        validate_inputs(report, original_notes)

        target_heading = find_target_heading(original_notes)
        section_start, section_end = find_target_section(
            original_notes,
            target_heading,
        )

        insertion_offset = original_notes.index(INSERTION_MARKER)

        if not section_start <= insertion_offset < section_end:
            fail(
                "The insertion marker is not inside the "
                "September 8, 2026 section."
            )

        newline = detect_newline(original_notes)
        report_block = build_report_block(report, newline)

        updated_notes = (
            original_notes[:insertion_offset]
            + report_block
            + original_notes[insertion_offset:]
        )

        verify_update(
            original_notes,
            updated_notes,
            report_block,
            insertion_offset,
        )

        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
        backup_path = notes_path.with_name(
            notes_path.name + ".backup_" + timestamp
        )

        try:
            shutil.copy2(notes_path, backup_path)
            notes_path.write_text(
                updated_notes,
                encoding="utf-8",
                newline="",
            )
        except OSError as error:
            fail("Unable to write the updated notes: {}".format(error))

        written_notes = read_utf8(
            notes_path,
            "updated meeting-notes file",
        )

        if written_notes != updated_notes:
            fail(
                "Post-write verification failed. Restore this backup: "
                + str(backup_path)
            )

        return backup_path


    def main():
        report_path = (
            Path(sys.argv[1])
            if len(sys.argv) >= 2
            else REPORT_PATH
        )

        notes_path = (
            Path(sys.argv[2])
            if len(sys.argv) >= 3
            else NOTES_PATH
        )

        if len(sys.argv) > 3:
            print(
                "Usage: python insert_q3_report.py "
                "[REPORT_PATH] [NOTES_PATH]",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 2

        try:
            backup_path = insert_report(report_path, notes_path)
        except Exception as error:
            print("ERROR: {}".format(error), file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

        print("SUCCESS: Q3 2026 business report inserted.")
        print("Destination: {}".format(notes_path))
        print("Backup: {}".format(backup_path))
        print("VERIFIED: Existing meeting-note content was preserved.")
        print("VERIFIED: Rachel Kim and Claire Fontaine are present.")
        print("VERIFIED: The insertion marker remains in place.")
        return 0


    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())
